items.root_cause: F2's residual: a builder meets a store rendering it has never seen, and its only outputs are a refusal line in a rejects file nobody reads and a smaller board. Nothing compares today's ingest with the store's own recent ingest, and a new unit spelling has no unattended way to be proven and kept, so the first reader of the change is a person, after the board shipped, and the same spelling can be met twice.

root_fix.what: every per-row capture builder records its ingest shape; a check at ingest compares it with the store's own 14 days, proves a new unit spelling by the store's own arithmetic and keeps the answer, or queues it with its rows
root_fix.exact_change: (1) ingest-shape-lib.ps1: Get-RejectReasonKey (lower case, every number to #, a quoted spelling KEPT, since it is the signal) and Write-IngestShape -Store -Date -RowsIn -RowsOut -Rejects, writing out/ingest-shape/<store>-<date>.json (gitignored): rows in and out, rejects by reason key, unit spellings seen. (2) the three builders call it once per build, after their rejects file, and read unit-aliases.json beside their own unit table. (3) audit-ingest-shape.ps1 runs in capture-run after the builders and BEFORE check-ad-cycles. Per store, a reason key or unit spelling absent from every file of the prior 14 days (at least 3 files, else it reports BLIND for that store and admits nothing) is a finding. For an 'unknown unit' spelling, Resolve-UnitSpelling proposes candidate families from the builder's own unit table after dropping a parenthetical qualifier and a plural s, then PROVES it: for every row carrying the spelling, line price / printed unit price reproduces a size the NAME states in that family within the store's printed-cent rounding (the pu_rounding_pct rule build-sams-deals already carries). Every row proved: the alias is written to unit-aliases.json with the proving rows and the date, and capture-run rebuilds that store before downstream. Any row unproved: nothing is admitted (the Aldi rule, 'resolved by arithmetic proof or not at all') and the finding is sent as 'Grocery: ingest shape - new unit spelling unproved' (new registry entry, review, resolver lane:grocery/audit-ingest-shape.ps1) with its rows. A new non-unit reason is printed in the chain summary and never sent (9 of the 16 measured were code-change wording, which the rehearsal owns). Marker: INGEST-SHAPE-COMPLETE stores= scanned= new= proved= unproved= blind=. (4) lib/bot-paths.ps1: unit-aliases.json joins the bot input paths so the daily commit carries it. The 14-day window and the 3-file minimum are first plausible values, not the survivors of a sweep.
